answer: Each identity ferments one vat of willow nectar, locks 85 credits as bond, and logs sugar, temperature, vat serial. An auditor checks the finished alcohol against the public nebula-season fermentation table; over 3% off or a reused serial burns the bond and voids the identity. First filing costs 36; the k-th by one funder costs 36+7(k-1), the 1,000th 7,029, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 in fees plus 85,000 locked. A rented-vat ring fails: each vat is keyed to one identity and the auditor re-measures the batch. An honest keeper pays 36 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
